column4: Pixel-art game sprite in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Redneck Rampage): chunky visible pixels, a limited muted palette, strong simple shading, a single object in the centre, full size. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around it, no ground shadow, no floor, no text, no border, no watermark. An old 1970s Eastern-bloc electric desk fan seen from the front, slightly from above: a round chrome wire grille cage over grey metal blades, a cream-coloured enamel motor housing behind, a short stem on a round heavy cream base with a small black switch.
